lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with significant layout changes hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, finish/hint, finish/notification, and finish/redesign, as each kind has only 1 test.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Behavior Cheat Sheet Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right after home intro that visually illustrates how the pet interacts with desktop windows and system tray.
candidates.why: Support received 7 emails regarding pet control/hiding confusion and desktop feature misbehavior, while finish step conversion is 64.8% with 395s median duration.

candidates.title: Account Recovery & Existing Pet Notice Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen to include clear account preservation warning components that remind returning users to sign into their original account.
candidates.why: Top support issue is returning users losing or resetting pets after signing in with a different account (8 emails).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pets
sign_in.body: Make sure to use the same account you registered previously to keep all your saved pets and progress.

candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for users (3 emails), and adoption drop-off is high (60.9% conversion, median 89s).

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Hint on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Adds a persistent hint on the waiting screen explaining how to verify screen rendering and system tray placement.

waiting.hint: If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, check if it was minimized to the system tray or secondary monitor.

candidates.score_note: Both support tickets and funnel stats support adding desktop rendering hints.

candidates.change: Updates sign-in screen headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud backup and cross-device pet restoration.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a mean duration of 567s. Clear benefit copy reduces sign-in hesitation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to the Cloud

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to clarify sync features without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change targeting sign-in hesitation.

candidates.why: Waiting screen has high drop-off (81.3% step conv) and median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s). Visual progress entertains users while loading.

guard.reason: Adds hatching animation to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info modifications showed no clear effect across 3 past tests.
